entities.name: PMID:25425302
observations: Compared 78 NTG eyes with 78 age- and axial-length-matched POAG eyes using OCT-derived ONH morphology.
NTG had greater ONH torsion; superior torsion occurred in 33.3% of NTG versus 10.3% of POAG.
Myopic NTG had greater torsion than nonmyopic NTG; torsion direction related to visual-field defect location.

entities.name: PMID:22595297
observations: Among 225 NTG eyes, disc torsion was present in 75.9% of myopic eyes versus a lower prevalence in nonmyopic eyes.
Torsion degree and direction were associated with the location of visual-field damage, particularly in myopic NTG.

entities.name: PMID:27755347
observations: In NTG eyes with tilted optic discs, greater torsion was associated with focal lamina cribrosa defects, while the defects—not torsion itself—were associated with visual-field progression.

entities.name: ONH torsion in NTG
observations: ONH torsion is a prominent morphologic feature in NTG relative to matched POAG, but it is not universal and is more pronounced in eyes with myopia or disc tilt.
